messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: bioconductor dependency
parts:
Hi Richard,
You aren't being a pest, apologies for not getting back to you sooner.  We have found the issue, it turns out that this particular package and 7 others are built in a way that is inconsistent with other packages and is actually on a special list that requires a different treatment.  
We think we know what we need to do to solve the issue, but it is behind a couple of items we are trying to get out this week.  We will keep you posted for sure, when is your submission deadline?

-Tareef

parts:
Richard,

I pushed a fix to master on the shinyapps package that I believe should address this issue. Please update the shinyapps package to the latest version from GitHub by doing:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

And then run:

deployApp()

Thanks
-Andy
